name: Warm Braided Apple Strudel with Vanilla Sauce & Ice Cream (Lantern Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
whyItWorks: Soft baked cinnamon apples in flaky strudel pastry; watch out for plump golden raisins tucked inside the apple filling.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick out any raisins/sultanas from the apple filling if flaring and take a Lactaid for the vanilla sauce and ice cream.
watchOuts: Dairy vanilla anglaise and ice cream
